Ceiling & Partition Foreman   Your new company      Hays has partnered with a highly regarded ceilings and partitions contractor that is helping deliver some of Brisbane's most prestigious luxury high-rise residential and mixed-use developments. With a strong pipeline of work secured and multiple landmark projects currently under construction, they have built a reputation for quality workmanship, strong client relationships and successfully delivering complex projects across South East Queensland.      Your new role       
 Due to continued growth, an opportunity has become available for an experienced Ceilings & Partitions Foreman to join the team. 
 Working closely with the Project Manager and Site Management team, you will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day delivery of partitions, framing, plasterboard, suspended ceilings and finishing works across major high-rise construction projects. 
   
 Key responsibilities include: 
   
 
 Managing site-based trades and subcontractors 
 Coordinating daily and weekly work programmes 
 Monitoring quality, safety and productivity on site 
 Ensuring works are delivered in line with project schedules 
 Conducting toolbox talks and site inspections 
 Liaising with builders, consultants and other trades 
 Assisting with procurement and material coordination 
 Driving a positive site culture and high-quality project outcomes 
 
   What you'll need to succeed       
 
 Previous experience as a Ceilings & Partitions Foreman, Supervisor or Leading Hand 
 Strong knowledge of commercial or high-rise residential construction 
 Experience managing partitioning, plasterboard and suspended ceiling packages 
 Ability to read and interpret construction drawings 
 Strong leadership and communication skills 
 Commitment to safety and quality outcomes 
 Current Construction White Card 
 Stable employment history and proven project delivery experience 
 
   What you'll get in return     
 
 Opportunity to work on some of Brisbane's most prestigious luxury tower developments 
 Long-term career progression with a growing contractor 
 Competitive salary package 
 Strong pipeline of secured projects 
 Supportive and collaborative leadership team 
 Exposure to large-scale, high-profile construction projects 
 Immediate start available

result.description:
Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of Jeay Sindh Pty Ltd T/A South Seoul Kelvin Grove

Date Posted: 10th July 2026

Position: Retail Manager

Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 per annum plus 12% Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full Time

Location: 2 Carraway Street Kelvin Grove QLD 4059

Experience required: Minimum 1 year experience relevant to the role

About Us

South Seoul is a vibrant and fast-growing Korean fried chicken and rice bowl restaurant that brings authentic flavours with a modern twist. We pride ourselves on using high-quality ingredients, innovative recipes, and friendly service to deliver a standout dining experience. With a loyal customer base and a focus on consistency, quality, and teamwork, South Seoul continues to make its mark as a go-to destination for Korean street food lovers in Australia.

Position:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to oversee the daily operations of South Seoul, ensuring smooth service, excellent customer experiences, and consistent business performance. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, operational know-how, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage daily store operations to ensure South Seoul runs efficiently during peak dining periods, maintaining high standards of food presentation, service quality, and cleanliness.

• Determine product mix and stock levels based on seasonal menu items, customer preferences, and delivery patterns—ensuring our most popular dishes, such as Korean fried chicken and rice bowls, are always available fresh.

• Formulate and implement purchasing and pricing policies that align with South Seoul’s brand promise of premium quality at accessible prices, balancing profitability with customer satisfaction.

• Promote and advertise the restaurant’s offerings through local marketing campaigns, social media engagement, and community partnerships to strengthen South Seoul’s visibility and attract repeat customers.

• Oversee customer interactions and service delivery, ensuring that every meal reflects South Seoul’s friendly, welcoming, and authentic Korean dining culture.

• Maintain accurate records of stock, sales, and financial transactions to support data-driven decision-making and cost management.

• Prepare and monitor budgets, identifying opportunities to improve performance while managing food and labour costs efficiently.

• Recruit, train, and develop team members who embody South Seoul’s values of teamwork, respect, and enthusiasm for great food.

• Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health standards, upholding South Seoul’s reputation for cleanliness and consistency.

Qualifications

• Tertiary qualification in Retail Management, Business Administration, or Hospitality Management (preferred but not required)

Skills & Requirements

• Minimum of 1 year experience in a supervisory or management role within the food or retail industry.

• Proven success in team leadership, operations, and customer service excellence.

• Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to motivate and manage a diverse team.

• Sound knowledge of inventory control, budgeting, and sales analysis.

• Passion for Korean cuisine and the hospitality industry.

• Familiarity with WHS and food safety compliance standards.

• Proficiency in POS systems, rostering, and operational reporting.

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your hospitality career and help South Seoul deliver unforgettable dining experiences, send your resume to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Join us and be part of the South Seoul story—where Korean flavours meet Australian hospitality.

Salary: $80,000 to $83,000 per annum

About Us: Spice Story Eatery, located in North Lakes, is a popular destination for authentic Indian cuisine. We pride ourselves on providing high-quality food and excellent service. As we continue to grow, we are looking to expand our team with a passionate chef who is eager to contribute to our dynamic kitchen.

Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Indian Cuisine Head Chef to join our team. If you have a passion for Indian cooking, especially with tandoor and curry dishes, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be the perfect role for you.

Key Responsibilities:
Planning and organising the preparation and cooking of meals in accordance with the restaurant’s menu and service requirements.
Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, including traditional Indian cuisine, tandoori items, curries, and regional specialties.
Estimating food and labour costs and assisting with the efficient ordering of food supplies and kitchen stock.
Monitoring the quality, taste, presentation, and consistency of dishes at all stages of preparation and service.
Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including food preparation, cooking processes, portion control, and meal service.
Discussing food preparation issues, menu planning, and kitchen operations with the Manager/Owner, kitchen staff, and waiting staff.
Demonstrating cooking techniques and advising kitchen staff on appropriate cooking procedures and presentation standards.
Ensuring all food is prepared and cooked in accordance with hygiene, food safety, and workplace health and safety requirements.
Explaining and enforcing hygiene regulations and maintaining a clean, safe, and organised kitchen environment.
Working collaboratively with kitchen and waiting staff to ensure smooth and timely food service.
Assisting with inventory control, stock rotation, and proper storage of food supplies.
Selecting, supervising, and training kitchen staff where required.
Freezing, preserving, and storing food items appropriately for future use where required.

Qualifications and Requirements:
Minimum 3 year of experience as an Indian Cuisine Chef.
Certificate III or IV in Commercial Cookery.
Diploma in Hospitality Management.
Experience in Tandoor and Curry cooking.
Must be available to work weekends.
Strong communication and teamwork skills.
